title: astragalus parnassi subsp. calabricus
intro: Astragalus parnassi subsp. calabricus, commonly known as Italian milk-vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to improve immune function and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Italian milk-vetch include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects, which may be beneficial for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
